info.name: Shoppable Commerce API Suite Catalog Orders API
Get details of a specified order

params.name: orderId
params.description: OrderId of the order you wish to return

items.docs: This endpoint is used to return the details of an order by order number

info.name: Get all orders associated with a specific campaign

params.name: campaignName
params.description: Name of the campaign associated with the orders you wish to return
